reason: Strongest continuous terraced perimeter blocks and the clearest church-west / guildhall-north / inn-east / market-south civic room. Its mixed roofs, gate road and closed blocks provide one drawing treatment for the rebuild.

alternatives.a: Kept as a comparison: weaker street rank and less decisive square enclosure.
alternatives.c: Kept as a comparison: compact rings, but weaker market grouping.
alternatives.a2: Rejected: simplified treatment loses the reference materials.

precedence: Coordinator C7 structure rules control the composed plan when a concept differs.
BRIEF-17 controls allocations, 1-2-cell lot footprints, 48px courses, required bends, signs and bounded overlays.
Panel suggestions to deepen footprints, widen the gate core, shrink signs, waive street variation or permit cross-property overlays were not adopted.
The explicit full C7 district request supersedes the older small-pilot/defer-expansion recommendation.
registration: Tool concept originals are 1448x1086. They are enlarged during registration to 1920x1440; the 8x working canvas is a sampling registration, not additional original drawing resolution. Individual production assets are reduced from larger painted sources.
